cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: Sodium Laureth Sulfate #2 buffered by Cocamidopropyl Betaine #4 and nonionic Cocamide MEA #8; Sodium Xylenesulfonate #3 is a hydrotrope and TEA-Dodecylbenzenesulfonate #16 a trace emulsifier; no reset intent (C1).

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: one silicone/cationic deposition system (Dimethiconol #11, Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride #13, Dimethicone #14) plus pearlizing Glycol Distearate #9; humectants Glycerin #23 and Panthenol #25 are trace. Silicones sit after Parfum #6, so the C2 'early silicone' pattern is not met.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: silicone + cationic + pearlizer + humectants resembles C2 (high)

weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: depositionLoad moderate (silicone gum + dimethicone + guar), persistence moderate, resetCapacity moderate (SLES/betaine). W1-type: silicone + cationic guar in an effective sulfate/betaine base, not a rich 2-in-1.
weightPotential.counterSignal: silicones after Parfum; effective cleansing base

focusPrimary.rationale: scalp_active: problem-led 'Anti-Schuppen' product with recognized active Piroctone Olamine #10 (7.2 row).

focusSecondary.rationale: Empty: the oily-scalp/itch claims are part of the anti-dandruff '3x Schutz' scalp role, and the only route for oil control is the ordinary cleansing chassis (restating cleansing, §8 condition 3).

usageRole.rationale: Treatment: supported anti-dandruff formula with problem-led positioning. The frequent trigger is also met ('ideal für die tägliche Anwendung', cleansing moderate); the problem-led trigger was preferred (§9 has no precedence rule).

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Not targeted: itch is claimed only as 'Juckreiz im Zusammenhang mit Schuppen' (a dandruff symptom), not sensitive-scalp positioning; formula has early Parfum #6 and only trace comfort routes (Niacinamide #24, Panthenol #25).

projection.thicknessRationale: T1 W moderate: fine acceptable, normal ideal, coarse acceptable (C moderate). T6: scalp-concern targets, nothing not_suited. T4: W neighbor low and C neighbor high raise fits -> no flag.
projection.scalpTargetRationale: S-DANDRUFF: 'Anti-Schuppen' in name (E1 high) + supported -> pass. S-OILY: distinct E2 claim 'fettige Kopfhaut' (manufacturer, E1 moderate); cleansing moderate, W moderate (not high), C moderate (not high) -> pass. S-SENSITIVE: 'Juckreiz' is an E2 claim but scalpComfortTarget not_targeted and no prominent comfort route (Panthenol/Niacinamide after Parfum #6) -> fails; S-FAIL does not apply because dandruff qualifies. Primary dandruff by name/precedence (S-PRIMARY). S-FOCUS satisfied.
projection.cleansingIntensityRationale: I1 moderate -> regular; equals schuppen and dehydriert-fettig expectations. No neighbor -> no I3.

uncertainties: S-SECONDARY: an anti-dandruff product listing oil as one of its '3x Schutz' scalp problems mechanically passes S-OILY and gains a full oily row set. Standard has no rule on whether a secondary scalp claim embedded in the primary problem statement is 'distinct'; also the oily gate has no positioning-strength threshold beyond E1. This is a toward_recommending ambiguity.

Inconsistency: focusSecondary rejects oil-control (no independent route beyond cleansing, §8), yet S-OILY projects an oily target; S-FOCUS checks only dandruff/sensitive/dry targets against focus, so no review is raised.
C2 cites an 'early Dimethicone'; the standard does not define 'early' relative to fragrance/E3. Silicones after Parfum treated as not early.
